issues.title: Hardcoded RabbitMQ Host Configuration
issues.description: RabbitMQ host is hardcoded as 'localhost' in the source code
issues.recommendation: Externalize configuration using environment variables or configuration files. Use Azure App Configuration or Key Vault for managing connection strings.
issues.azureGuidance: Use Azure App Configuration service to manage application settings across environments

issues.title: Hardcoded Queue Name
issues.description: RabbitMQ queue name is hardcoded in the source code
issues.recommendation: Move queue name to external configuration to enable environment-specific values
issues.azureGuidance: Configure queue/topic names through Azure App Configuration

issues.title: RabbitMQ Dependency
issues.description: Application uses RabbitMQ for message queuing, which requires migration to Azure messaging services
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Service Bus or Azure Event Hubs. Azure Service Bus provides RabbitMQ protocol support via AMQP.
issues.azureGuidance: Azure Service Bus supports AMQP 1.0 protocol and can work with minimal code changes

issues.title: Missing Connection Credentials Configuration
issues.description: RabbitMQ connection credentials are commented out and not properly configured
issues.recommendation: Implement proper authentication using Azure Key Vault for secure credential management
issues.azureGuidance: Use Azure Key Vault to store connection strings and credentials securely

issues.title: Embedded Jetty Server
issues.description: Application uses embedded Jetty server for development, needs migration to Azure App Service
issues.recommendation: Deploy WAR file to Azure App Service (Tomcat runtime) or containerize the application
issues.azureGuidance: Azure App Service supports WAR deployment with Tomcat runtime

issues.title: Java 8 (1.8) Usage
issues.description: Application uses Java 8 which is approaching end of support
issues.recommendation: Consider upgrading to Java 11 or Java 17 (LTS versions) for better long-term support
issues.azureGuidance: Azure App Service supports Java 8, 11, and 17. Java 17 is recommended for new deployments

issues.title: WebSocket Implementation
issues.description: Application uses WebSocket for real-time communication
issues.recommendation: Verify WebSocket support in target Azure service. Azure App Service supports WebSocket.
issues.azureGuidance: Enable WebSocket support in Azure App Service configuration

issues.title: Basic Error Handling
issues.description: Error handling relies on console output and stack traces
issues.recommendation: Implement structured logging using Azure Application Insights for better observability
issues.azureGuidance: Integrate Azure Application Insights for application monitoring and diagnostics

issues.title: Outdated Gson Version
issues.recommendation: Update to latest Gson version (2.10.1 or later) for bug fixes and improvements
issues.azureGuidance: No specific Azure guidance - standard dependency update

issues.title: Outdated JUnit Version
issues.description: Using JUnit 4.11, consider upgrading to JUnit 5
issues.recommendation: Upgrade to JUnit 5 for better testing capabilities
issues.azureGuidance: No specific Azure guidance - standard dependency update

issues.title: No Application Monitoring
issues.description: Application lacks integrated monitoring and telemetry
issues.recommendation: Add Azure Application Insights SDK for comprehensive application monitoring
issues.azureGuidance: Integrate Application Insights Java agent for automatic telemetry collection

issues.title: No Dockerfile Present
issues.recommendation: Create Dockerfile for containerized deployment to Azure Container Apps or AKS
issues.azureGuidance: Use Azure Container Registry to store container images

recommendations.title: Externalize Configuration
recommendations.description: Move all hardcoded configuration values to external configuration sources
benefits: Improve security by separating secrets from code

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Service Bus
recommendations.description: Replace RabbitMQ with Azure Service Bus for cloud-native messaging
benefits: Built-in high availability and disaster recovery

alternativeOptions.description: Lift-and-shift approach with minimal code changes

recommendations.title: Implement Application Insights

recommendations.title: Upgrade to Java 17 LTS
recommendations.description: Modernize the Java runtime to the latest LTS version
